name: Summer Art Camps for Kids
description_short: A week-long art camp for children ages 7-11, run by the Westport Art Group at its building in Westport Point, MA. All materials are included, and each session takes up to 12 campers.
refund_policy_summary: You pay the full fee when you register. If you withdraw at least 1 month before camp and the spot is filled from the waiting list, you get a full refund minus a $10 processing fee. If you cancel less than 1 month before, there is no refund unless the spot is filled from the waiting list, and then you get 75% back. If WAG cancels a camp, you get a full refund.
